name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: v0.25.1 hotfix: the v0.25.0 RECONCILE same-issue dedup (C) crashed the whole tick on gh 2.69.0. FIX 1 (the crash): gh_open_pr_closing_issue_source requested closingIssuesReferences on `gh pr list` (a `gh pr view`-only --json field, invalid on list -> gh non-zero -> check=True aborts the tick); rewritten to LIST with supported fields only (`gh pr list --json number,url`, + --repo when set) and resolve each PR's first closing-issue ref via the EXISTING gh_closing_issue_ref (`gh pr view <n> --json closingIssuesReferences`), excluding PRs that close no issue; runner threaded into both calls; closingIssuesReferences is NEVER requested on `gh pr list`. FIX 2 (advisory fault-isolation): the ENTIRE (C) dedup step (the source call AND the per-group grouping+close loop) is wrapped in try/except that records any fault under reconcile_result.errors as {ref:'dedup', reason} and CONTINUES (dedup degrades to a no-op); RECONCILE stays advisory (emits only OK, never raises/aborts). Existing per-close trust-gate + deduped recording preserved. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored (spec.md 515 -> 537).
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already updated + committed on this branch (e6ba000) with the RECONCILE (C) dedup gh-query-shape clarification + fault-isolation invariant for this hotfix; this cycle implements them in src + tests
